description: This file defines the TestRootCerts class and related helpers for managing trusted root certificates in unit tests, including platform-specific handling for Windows and iOS.

classes.name: TestRootCerts
classes.description: Helper class for managing trusted root certificates in tests, with platform-specific implementations for Windows and iOS.

classes.name: ScopedTestRoot
classes.description: Scoped helper class to temporarily add certificates as trusted roots during tests.

classes.name: ScopedTestKnownRoot
classes.description: Scoped helper class to mark certificates as known roots without trusting them.

methods.name: HasInstance
methods.description: Checks if an instance of TestRootCerts exists.

methods.name: IsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if no certificates are trusted.

methods.name: IsKnownRoot
methods.description: Checks if a DER-encoded certificate is a known root.

methods.name: FixupSecTrustRef
methods.description: Modifies a SecTrustRef to include test roots (iOS).

methods.name: GetChainEngine
methods.description: Returns a chain engine for validation (Windows).

methods.name: test_trust_store
methods.description: Returns the in-memory trust store used for testing.

methods.name: ScopedTestRoot
methods.description: Constructor, destructor, and reset methods for managing temporary trusted roots.

methods.name: ScopedTestKnownRoot
methods.description: Constructor and destructor for managing known root certificates.
